title: Add offline upgrade orchestration + rollback hooks; introduce Terraform registry-mirror module
author: Sasha Kim
release_notes: Added terraform module to provision an offline registry mirror with idempotent bootstrap and TTL-based GC
Upgrade operator for air-gapped clusters: orchestrates image delta application, Helm upgrades, and pre/post hooks
Rollback hooks and snapshot/restore integration (Velero) for safe revert of upgrades
Helm chart values: offline mirror config, imageManifest path, probe timeouts adjusted for slow pull
E2E test harness for offline upgrade paths added to CI (runs behind a local registry emulator)
description:
Motivation: customers running Private (on-prem / air-gapped) environments need a deterministic, repeatable upgrade flow that works without outbound access and provides a safe rollback path when a rollout causes regressions. This PR delivers three coordinated changes: 1) a terraform module to provision a local/offline registry mirror and associated registry-proxy bootstrap artifacts; 2) an upgrade operator (lightweight controller) that sequences offline upgrade delta bundles, Helm upgrades, and pre/post hooks; 3) explicit rollback hooks that snapshot state and can restore workloads using Velero snapshots and stored image manifests.

What changed (high level):
- terraform/modules/registry-mirror: new module that creates an airgap-ready registry mirror config (image catalog, mirror policy, TLS assets, basic auth) and outputs a canonical imageManifest location for installer to consume. Module is idempotent and supports both single-host mirror and replicated mirror groups.
- installer/upgrade-operator: new component (controller + CLI) that accepts an offline bundle (tar.gz) or a manifest URL and performs a dry-run, preflight checks, image pre-cache via the registry mirror, Helm chart upgrade with explicit value overrides, and then a health-check window. If health checks fail, operator triggers rollback hooks.
- installer/rollback-hooks: snapshots etcd and selected PVCs via Velero integration, records image-manifest and helm-release revision, and stores metadata in the local mirror path for audit.
- helm-charts/redwood: added values for offline.imageManifest, imagePullConfig, registryMirrors, and increased readiness/liveness probe timeouts for slow air-gapped pulls.
- tests/e2e/airgap-upgrade: harness that spins up a k3s cluster, a local registry-mirror container, and runs an upgrade cycle using the operator. The test is kept gated behind a CI label and a short timeout.

Checklist: 
- [x] Terraform module added and docs with example usage
- [x] Upgrade operator implementation + unit tests
- [x] Rollback snapshot/restore integration with Velero (optional in test)
- [x] Helm chart value bindings and documentation update
- [x] E2E harness and CI job (gated)

Compatibility notes: This change is additive; existing installer workflows continue to work when imageManifest is not provided. The terraform module supports multiple OS families (tested on Ubuntu 20.04, AlmaLinux 8, and SLES 15) and can be used by cloud-based mirror hosts or on-prem VMs.

Related: ENG-1789 (airgap upgrade strategy), ENG-1820 (registry mirror terraform), SUP-332 (customer incident that motivated rollback automation).
